result.stdout:
Usage: digest [options]

Cross-platform cryptographic hashing and HMAC — SHA-2/SHA-3/BLAKE2b, safe HMAC key handling.

Options:
  --sha256            SHA-256 (default)
  --sha384            SHA-384
  --sha512            SHA-512
  --sha1              SHA-1 (legacy; emits warning)
  --md5               MD5 (legacy; emits warning)
  --sha3-256          SHA3-256
  --sha3-512          SHA3-512
  --blake2b           BLAKE2b-512
  --key-stdin         Read HMAC key from stdin
  --key-raw           Preserve bytes on --key-file / --key-stdin (skip trailing-newline strip)
  --hex               Hex output (default, lowercase)
  --base64            Base64 output (standard alphabet)
  --base64-url        Base64 URL-safe variant
  --base32            Crockford base32 output
  -u, --uppercase     Uppercase hex output
  -a, --algo ALGO     Alternative to individual algorithm flags: sha256, sha384, sha512, sha1, md5, sha3-256, sha3-512, blake2b
  --hmac ALGO         HMAC mode using the given hash algorithm (requires a key source)
  --key-env VAR       Read HMAC key from environment variable
  --key-file PATH     Read HMAC key from file (Unix permission warning if group/other readable)
  --key KEY           HMAC key as literal argument (emits warning about process visibility)
  -s, --string VALUE  Hash the literal string VALUE (UTF-8 bytes). Exclusive with positional file args.
  --verify EXPECTED   Compare output (constant-time); exit 0 if match, 1 if mismatch
  -h, --help          Show help
  --version           Show version
  --color             Force colored output
  --no-color          Disable colored output
  --json              JSON output
  --describe          Structured JSON metadata for AI agents

Exit Codes:
  0    Success
  125  Usage error: bad flags, unknown value, flag conflict, missing file, empty HMAC key, or key file too large
  1    Verification failed (digest --verify mismatch)
  126  Runtime error: SHA-3 unavailable on this platform, file read failure, key file read failure, or generic catch-all
